class Solution:
    def maxFrequencyScore(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        mod = 10**9 + 7
        cnt = Counter(nums[:k])
        ans = cur = sum(pow(k, v, mod) for k, v in cnt.items()) % mod
        i = k
        while i < len(nums):
            a, b = nums[i - k], nums[i]
            if a != b:
                cur += (b - 1) * pow(b, cnt[b], mod) if cnt[b] else b
                cur -= (a - 1) * pow(a, cnt[a] - 1, mod) if cnt[a] > 1 else a
                cur %= mod
                cnt[b] += 1
                cnt[a] -= 1
                ans = max(ans, cur)
            i += 1
        return ans
